mentions.name: FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE release engineering
mentions.description: Release engineering effort for FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE, switching the base system distribution from a single tarball to around 500 packages, with resulting changes to the build process, download/update mirrors, and installer. This is the biggest release in 20 years due to the new base system distribution system.
mentions.problem: Major releases are always a lot of work; this is probably the biggest release in 20 years due to the new base system distribution system landing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Release engineering for FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE.  Major releases are always a lot of work, but this is probably the biggest release in 20 years due to the new base system distribution system landing.  (We're switching from "here's a tarball containing everything" to "here's 500 packages", with resulting changes in the build process, download/update mirrors, installer, etc.)
